svg.title: Waste collection worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as waste collection worker, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tapered lidded collection bin has a broad upper handle and two separated low wheels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
